Chapter 1336: 17: Lin Yuan'S Trial

Chapter 1336: Chapter 17: Lin Yuan’s Trial

The power of time flows like water, creating ripples upon ripples.

Dragging Lin Yuan’s physical form towards the depths of the Chaos Void.

Under the pull of the time power that has begun to cycle.

Lin Yuan’s mental will quickly becomes blurred.

Completely losing control over the external world.

Just as Lin Yuan’s physical form plunges into the deepest part of the Chaos Void, into the region of time cycles where all Chaos Realm beings attempting to break through to the thirteenth stage have invariably found themselves.

Dong!

A brand new time cycle region, unprecedented and far surpassing the collective sum of all existing time cycle regions, begins to rapidly take shape.

The new time cycle region is boundless.

Compared to the time cycle regions that other perfected Chaos Realm beings are trapped in, which can be likened to a pebble.

The newly emerged time cycle region is a stellar entity, vast and illuminating all corners.

…

The gathering of time power and the upheaval in the deepest part of the Chaos Void did not go unnoticed by the time beings.

Lord Mo Xu and others at the thirteenth stage were already extraordinarily concerned about Lin Yuan, and upon detecting the anomaly in the power of time, they realized that Lin Yuan was beginning to break through to the thirteenth stage.

“The Galaxy is finally going to break through.”

“The Chaos Void is about to give birth to the ninth time being.”

One by one, the time beings felt a sense of joy; first, the unexpected delight of Luo Hou’s ascent to the thirteenth stage, and now Lin Yuan, whom they hold in high esteem, is also beginning to break through to the thirteenth stage.

According to the previously observed future timeline, Lin Yuan’s becoming a time being is a certainty.

Very soon.

Many time beings also observed the changes in the time cycle region in the deepest part of the Chaos Void.

Especially the newly emerged region, which encompasses almost all time cycle regions, causing the time beings to widen their eyes.

“The time cycle the Galaxy has fallen into, the resulting cycle region, is too vast…”

A time being could not help but exclaim. When a perfected Chaos Realm being attempts the thirteenth stage and is trapped in a time cycle, there are variations in size.

It specifically depends on the power realm of this perfected Chaos Realm being.

For example, when a Great Saint of unparalleled might attempts the thirteenth stage, the resulting time cycle region is much larger than that of an ordinary Chaos Great Saint.

And when an Invincible Great Saint attempts the thirteenth stage, the resulting time cycle region is even larger than that of the Great Saint.

But Lin Yuan?

When Lin Yuan attempts the thirteenth stage, the time cycle he falls into results in a cycle region that is beyond merely immense.

All previous cycle regions combined do not equal one billionth of the cycle region formed by Lin Yuan, truly terrifying.

Though the time beings present had long anticipated this, having observed Lin Yuan’s prowess in the future timeline, they hadn’t expected the final time cycle region formed to be this infinitely vast.

The size of a time cycle region most intuitively reflects the strength of a being.

This is the supreme law of the infinite dimensional planes, the ultimate appraisal of a being.

“Galaxy…”

Luo Hou was equally dumbfounded; he had just broken through a time cycle not long ago, aware of the size of the cycle region he was trapped in.

In comparison to Lin Yuan’s time cycle region, the glow of a firefly and the brightness of a bright moon would be praises, indeed.

This signifies the former’s strength to exceed Luo Hou’s understanding.

It may even surpass the understanding of veteran and seasoned time beings like Lord Mo Xu.

“Could the Galaxy’s strength, having just crossed into the thirteenth stage, surpass mine already?”

Lord Mo Xu, observing the endlessly vast brand new time cycle region, couldn’t help but let this thought surface in his mind.

He was the first time being born in the Chaos Void, with a deep accumulation in the First Realm of the thirteenth stage.

Usually, newly advanced thirteenth stage beings are not his match.

Considering Lin Yuan’s nearly certain future timeline as a Time Lord, Lord Mo Xu had no doubt that the other would surpass him.

But that would be after hundreds of thousands to millions to tens of millions of years of being a time being.

In fact, hundreds of thousands to millions to tens of millions of years is considered extremely short for a time being.

Just having become a time being, without having adapted to the surge of power, one cannot wield the true power of the thirteenth stage.

Yet now, observing the brand new time cycle region, Lord Mo Xu was a bit uncertain.

…

Lin Yuan’s perception was exceedingly blurred, only sensing his mental will perpetually falling, falling, falling.

…

“Young Master, hold on a little longer, soon I will shake them off.”

“Young Master, you rest here for a while, I’ll go distract them.”

“Young Master, I’m back, it’s safe now.”

“Young Master, Young Master wake up, if you die, how will I account to the old master…”

Lin Yuan vaguely heard some voices, instinctively understanding their meaning, yet due to his overly weak mental will, he couldn’t wake up and was forced to remain asleep.

As time passed, Lin Yuan’s consciousness gradually began to recover, although still far from its full state, he could at least try to receive more external information.

Finally, one day.

Lin Yuan very laboriously opened his eyes.

The light was somewhat glaring, but Lin Yuan didn’t care about that, as a flood of memories began to surge in his mind.

“The Da Feng Dynasty rules the world, and my identity is the Young Master of the Red Lotus Sect?”

“The Red Lotus Sect aims for rebellion as its ultimate goal, wishing to overthrow the Da Feng Dynasty’s rule? Thus receiving the full-force suppression from the Da Feng Dynasty.”

“My father, the Red Lotus Sect Leader, died not long ago in a court siege, and an old servant under my father’s command risked his life to save me?”

Lin Yuan understood, roughly comprehending his situation.
